gold.historyOfPresentIllness: A 12-year-old male presents with left ear pain and hearing loss for approximately four days, accompanied by ear drainage. The patient was seen at an urgent care two days prior and prescribed ear drops, which have not provided relief and are causing a sensation of clogging. Physical examination reveals a perforated right eardrum with left OE and AOM
